							inCount++;
						}
						i++;
					}
					if (text.charAt(i)==')') {
						count=0;
						break;
					}
					count=0;
					i++;
				} else {
					int outCount = 0;
					while (text.charAt(i) != '_' && text.charAt(i)!=')' && text.charAt(i)!='(') {
						count++;
						outCount++;
						i++;
					}
					if (outMax < outCount) {
						outMax = outCount;
						count = 0;
					}
					if (text.charAt(i)=='(') {
						count=0;
					}
					i++;
				}
			}
		} catch (Exception e) {

		}finally{
			if (outMax < count) {
				outMax = count;
			}
		}

		System.out.print(outMax + " " + inMax);

	}

}
